supersedes: ide-error-diagnostic-receipt.json (initial three-file mapping proposal; historical only)
scope: VS Code diagnostic projection and explicit recurring-input recovery boundaries. Eight files. No SDK/Core/CLI/version changes, commits, pushes, workflow dispatch, dependency installation or publication.
changes: Restore actionable error/result prose for ordinary errors; append only a valid optional machine code. Do not attach a fabricated persistence phase to ordinary errors.

Known persistence result subtypes/codes use fixed Session persistence failed text, bounded code and persistence.phase allowlist plus inspect-session guidance. Same classification prevents persistence error prose appearing through mode status or LLM setup-card fan-out.

Pause existing user-enabled /loop on known persistence results, acceptance unknown, session_error, ambiguous write failure, and process close with nonzero code/signal or an unfinished active turn. Show manual session/acceptance review guidance; never auto-restart the loop.
Bind each scheduled submission to its loop object; reject a paused/replaced loop's asynchronous prepared input before dispatch.

Keep ordinary successful and generic-error loops unchanged. Clean zero exit after a completed result allows the next scheduled turn. Old process tokens and other-session result callbacks cannot pause the current loop.
Preserve tool trace rows and existing transcript state on pause. No code clears or mutates canonical CLI tool results; no tool replay added.
Spawn/EPIPE events retain bounded machine codes. Abnormal close displays CC_AGENT_PROCESS_EXITED plus safe numeric exit code and bounded signal; no phase inferred.

classification.precondition: type result and is_error strictly true for persistence classification
classification.machineCode: String length <=120, starts A-Z, remaining characters only A-Z/0-9/underscore. No coercion/truncation; trailing newline rejected.
classification.unknownAcceptance: result.acceptance === unknown independently stops recurring input
classification.processExit: code !== 0 OR signal truthy OR current.turnActive

tests.name: expanded red-first regressions
tests.details: Before implementation: loop continued sending 5 additional prompts in 5 simulated seconds; ordinary reason was hidden; EPIPE/spawn code absent. Clean close success control already passed.

tests.name: initial expanded targeted green
tests.details: Intermediate focused result; strengthened preparation race and additional fan-out/stale-event tests subsequently included in final full suite.

tests.name: final full package test:unit
tests.details: Includes actual ChatView event dispatch, production _setLoop/_handleMessage/_sendMessage/_sendDurableMessage with mock interval clocks and fake child session seam; generated terminal renderer runs in vm; not a real Extension Host.

auditDisposition.status: Fixed for persistence errors only; ordinary provider/configuration prose deliberately remains actionable.
Bounded codes now retained on spawn/EPIPE and abnormal close signal/exit diagnostic added. No invented phase.
Fixed explicit /loop continuation on known session-consistency/unknown-delivery/process failures, including already-preparing input. Normal recurring work retained.
Out of scope: malformed error subtype lacking true is_error still depends on protocol correctness. Valid CLI result shape is covered.
No canonical tool loss found; pause preserves existing tool trace rows. Existing tool_done detail retention on view rebuild is unchanged and remains separate UI work.
Unchanged: canonical assistant finalText may be retained from evt.result with valid transcript_refs shape; budget/success/interruption handling unchanged. No global all-content sanitization claim.

requiredGatePlan: Review and integrate this three-file patch onto intended final release commit; any integration changes invalidate exact-source local test equivalence.
Run GitHub Actions IDE Extensions on exact final commit: capability-manifest prerequisites (release metadata, roadmap fixtures, manifest drift, publication prerequisite contract).
Complete all three OS browser evidence producers and required aggregate: browser contracts, actual image codecs, Workbench browser with real CLI persistence, local two-origin journey.

vscode-package: full unit suite, Marketplace overview, SDK/protocol and elicitation freshness, marketplace self-test, pinned vsce 3.9.2 package --no-dependencies, VSIX verifier self-test and actual VSIX verification, immutable candidate manifest bound to final commit/hash.
Run same immutable VSIX through Windows stable and minimum 1.85.2; macOS stable and minimum 1.85.2; Linux stable and minimum 1.85.2 multi-root/multi-window real Extension Host journeys.
Run same candidate through genuine Remote-SSH container host and required trusted scoped roadmap aggregate.
If combined IDE release is intended, preserve applicable JetBrains complete three-OS supported IDE matrix/build/compatibility gates. No bypass because this patch is VS Code only.

Before IDE publication verify required CLI release is fetchable and version pairing aligned. CLI release itself requires exact-commit CLI CI and CLI Strict Sandbox complete OS matrices, child packages before CLI, OIDC trusted npm publishing. Publication is outside this task authorization.
notRun: Actual VSIX packaging (new src/chat/agent-diagnostics.js must be included and verified in immutable candidate)
Installed Extension Host on Linux/Windows/macOS stable and minimum versions
GitHub Actions on integrated final commit
Live provider reproduction or CLI persistence-root-cause verification
claims: Local VS Code regression validation only. This prevents known repeated IDE loop submissions and improves diagnostics; it is not the CLI root-cause fix or release qualification.
